title: Specs first: features/daw/notes.feature and its steps
description:
## Intent

Write the M2 specs first and watch them fail.

## Steps

- `features/daw/notes.feature` from the M2 stories (kits, overlapping notes, reverse, re-pitch and speed, ranges); new steps added to `features/daw/STEPS.md` and `crates/apricity-daw/tests/daw.rs`.
- Given steps build kits, pitched tracks and flips with `.apr` text plus generated WAVs/manifests (a manifest with no beats for the speech case, like `speech_fixture` in `crates/apricity-score/tests/compile.rs`).
- Then steps compare clips with the compiled timeline (`apricity_score::compile_file`) rather than restating numbers, where the story says "as compiled".

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` runs the new scenarios; each fails for missing behavior. List them in a comment.

## Release

`test(<this task's id>): specs for kits, overlaps, reverse and speed in DAW sets`, or folded into the first M2 feat commit.
